Fresh paint and a new green door: the shopfront's done. Open Monday to Saturday 7 to 18, Sunday 8 to 12. Come by for a coffee and tell us what you think. We've baked an extra tray of cinnamon rolls for the occasion, first come, first served. See you soon!
